payload.title: How is a candidate's review recorded, and does it count against the run's cap?
payload.body: Today a review is its own Experiment and Result (runs 1 and 2), so a candidate costs a gate Result and a review Result. Scenario: replay cut 1 (R-8JQPWG) and cut 2 (R-JHBCWS) under each Arm; count Results recorded under the actor at the stop and whether each final candidate has a review Result.

why: Grill for #141, 2026-11-13. The record rivals of #141 answer one question.

payload.title: What does the run do as its cap nears with a candidate unreviewed?
payload.body: Run 1 stopped at 5 Results with 5c5902d unreviewed and unnamed; run 2 stopped with 3cfd08d unreviewed and named. Scenario: replay cut 1, where 4 of 5 Results are spent and a fix is pending (3 are left at cap 7); see whether the trial ends with the final candidate reviewed or named, and its cost against the baseline.

why: Grill for #141, 2026-11-13. The cap rivals of #141 answer one question.

payload.title: What does a review finding become when the run's own probe passes the case?
payload.body: Today a finding that is a case of a line is a limit, so run 3's N1 and P1, which the code passed, each led to a fix commit and a new review. Scenario: replay cut 2, after R-JHBCWS; see whether the trial adds a commit after a review whose findings all pass their probes, and the chain's cost.

why: Grill for #141, 2026-11-13. The probe rivals of #141 answer one question.

payload.title: What does the review before the select read: the last increment or the whole candidate?
payload.body: Since 10566d4 each review read only the latest fix diff, so the code at the final candidate was never read in one piece against the lines. Scenario: replay cut 1 and cut 2; see which diff the trial's fresh reviewer is given, whether findings differ, and the cost.

why: Grill for #141, 2026-11-13. The scope rivals of #141 answer one question.

payload.title: Baseline: a review is its own Experiment and Result
payload.body: Today's practice: skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md at sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e, cap 5, no patch. A review is recorded as a separate Experiment (recipe none, rubric reading) whose Result counts against the cap.

payload.title: H-one-experiment: the review is part of the candidate's gate Experiment
payload.body: One Result carries the gate's test verdicts and the review's limits, so a candidate costs one Result. Arm: a patch over SKILL.md that says so; cap 5.

payload.title: Baseline: no rule for the last Result of the cap
payload.body: Today's practice: skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md at sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e, cap 5, no patch. Nothing says what yields when one Result is left: the cap or the review.

payload.title: H-name-at-stop: the stop checkpoint names each unreviewed candidate
payload.body: Arm: a patch over SKILL.md that makes the stop checkpoint name each candidate with no review Result by Hypothesis id and commit; cap 5. Holds alone or with any other rival.

payload.title: H-reserve-last: with one Result left the run reviews the current candidate
payload.body: Arm: a patch over SKILL.md that, with one Result left, makes the run review its current candidate instead of committing another fix, record its limits, and stop; cap 5.

payload.title: H-raise-budget: the cap is 7 Results
payload.body: Arm: no text patch; hyp prompt --experiments 7 on the same cuts. Owner's comment of 2026-11-12 argues a fixed cap ends unreviewed anyway; the owner chose to test it.

payload.title: Baseline: a finding that is a case of a line is a limit
payload.body: Today's practice: skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md at sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e, cap 5, no patch. A case the run's own probe passes is still recorded as a limit and closed by a test commit.

payload.title: H-probe-closes: a case the run's probe passes is closed in the review's Result
payload.body: Arm: a patch over SKILL.md. A case a probe ran and passed on the candidate is closed in the review's Result, not recorded as a limit; a limit stays for a case no check ran or one the candidate fails. Cap 5.

payload.title: Baseline: the review reads the latest increment
payload.body: Today's practice: skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md at sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e, cap 5, no patch. The fresh reviewer is given the diff of the last commit against its parent.

payload.title: H-whole-candidate: the review before the select reads the cumulative diff
payload.body: Arm: a patch over SKILL.md. The review before the select reads the diff from the Goal's base to the candidate, not the last increment. Cap 5.

why: The issue this discovery Goal serves.
The parent issue, #141 is part of it.

payload.summary: Grill done: 7 lines written by owner-standin; 4 DesignQuestions (record, cap, probe, scope) with 10 rivals, today's practice a rival in each. Every rival is replayed alone from two cuts; combinations and the build of the selected practice are later Goals. Out-of-Goal: the base commits carry a committed copy of this store (the recipe must keep trials off it); a build Goal must state how a review is recorded and whether it counts against the cap.
